Job Opportunity at Goa College of Music
Role: Lower Division Clerk (LDC)
Department: Examination Section
Type: Contractual for 12 months
Vacancy: 1
Pay: ₹5200 + ₹1900 + DA (as per 6th Pay Commission)
Location: Altinho, Panaji, Goa
Required Qualifications:
Higher Secondary School Certificate
Computer typing speed of 30 wpm in English
Knowledge of Konkani
Desired Qualification:
Knowledge of Marathi
Age Limit: As per Government of Goa rules
How to Apply:
Submit your application with a recent passport-sized photo and copies of relevant documents to the Principal, Goa College of Music. Ensure all details are clear and attested copies are attached.
Deadline: October 13, 2026, 4:15 PM
Further Process:
Eligible candidates will be contacted for a written exam. The venue and date will be shared via email.
Incomplete or late applications will be rejected.
